changelog:
multi-search-engine v1.0.0

- Initial public release.
- Integrates 16 search engines (7 Chinese, 9 global) for multi-source, API-key-free web search.
- Supports advanced search operators, time filters, site-specific, filetype, and privacy-focused search.
- Dynamic, in-memory cookie management improves access reliability; cookies are never stored on disk.
- Controlled batching and rate limiting to minimize search engine load and avoid access denial.
- Aggregates and summarizes results across engines, including support for WolframAlpha knowledge queries.
